## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (99%)** · Unreliable input · Careful review
Flagged reliability, model disagreement, and degraded frozen section support drafted recuts/levels and deferring margins [F7].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Normal 99%, Benign 1%, InSitu/Invasive 0% [F1] | Favors Normal; 0% invasive |
| Conformal set | {Normal}, α=0.1 (90% coverage, n=132) | Single-class dataset guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 44% (flagged), 100% OOD, JPEG-3 [F6] | Suspect degraded OOD input |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | False (top classes differ) | Foundation models disagree |
| Similar cases | 4/5 Normal (80%) [F5]; 1 InSitu (BACH_0300, 79%) | Mostly Normal; InSitu neighbor |

## Tissue evidence
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (regions 1, 4) · context · Above typical (1.58, -0.92 shift) [F2]; 8/20 spot-checked · Weak
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 0, 1, 2) · ↓ invasive · Above typical (1.32, -0.48 shift) [F3]; 18/20 spot-checked · Weak
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 1) · ↓ invasive · Below typical (0.20, -0.38 shift) [F4]; 19/20 spot-checked · Validated
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (region 1) · ↓ invasive · Below typical (-0.44, -0.36 shift); 0/20 spot-checked, unreliable · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; top-3 risk removal beats random (+0.0114, 95% CI +0.0021 to +0.0197, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unproven (CI -0.0088 to +0.0064 includes 0); mitoses (0/20), necrosis (3/20), normal lobules (0/20) are unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- JPEG-3 degradation and frozen-section artifact (44% reliability, 100% OOD) mask atypia and cause model disagreement.
- Unreliable necrosis (3/20) and weak lymphocyte (8/20) scores miss InSitu like BACH_0300 (79% similarity).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 6, 11, 8**: Highest tile risks (7%, 5%, 3%); exclude occult atypia or invasion.
2. **Regions 3, 7, 8**: Check duct-confined atypia (region 3) and lateral (79%)/inferior (69%) margins.
3. **Regions 0, 1, 2, 4**: Confirm benign tubules/TILs; consider drafted recut H&E and deeper levels.
